as_told.title: Mario Woods hears 'do not fear' during abduction
as_told.place_text: Ellsworth Air Force Base, South Dakota

tellings.quote: But I saw something like shadows on the right side of the vehicle and I have a memory of voices in my head, more than one, saying , ‘Do not fear’, over and over.

plain: During his 1977 encounter at an Air Force nuclear missile site in South Dakota, Mario Woods says, beings spoke to him without sound, repeating "do not fear" over and over, a message he felt travel through his body like a vibration or a hiss, which he calls telepathic. Woods, then a missile security guard, tells Michels this on several episodes, and once adds that he recognized the voice and remarks on its accent. In his account published by the writer Robert Hastings on 10 September 2017, he writes that he saw "something like shadows on the right side of the vehicle" and remembers "voices in my head, more than one, saying, 'Do not fear', over and over", which, if true, would mean the beings were speaking to him directly.
